title: Geographic Profiling of Invading Species
author: Alessio Papini and Ugo Santosuosso
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.kytcxwn

steps.title: Run silhouette analysis
steps.instruction: Execute the silhouette script to evaluate cluster numbers and optionally generate a plot.

substeps.instruction: Run: `python kmeans_sil_0_0_2.py caulerpaprol.csv 4 G` – the argument `G` produces a graphical silhouette (saved as a PNG if desired); use `N` instead of `G` to suppress the graphic.
Record the optimal number of clusters indicated by the silhouette plot; this number will be used in the next step.

steps.title: Edit geokmeans script parameters
steps.instruction: Modify the header of `scriptgeokmeans_1.0.py` to match your data files and chosen cluster count.

substeps.instruction: Set the observation CSV file name to `caulerpaprol.csv`.
Set the map image file name to `mediterraneolarge.bmp`.
Set the number of clusters to the optimal value obtained from the silhouette analysis (e.g., 4).

steps.title: Execute kmeans clustering (no graph)
steps.instruction: Run the k‑means clustering script without producing a map graphic.

substeps.instruction: Run: `python kmeans0_57.py caulerpaprol.csv 4 N` – the `N` flag suppresses the cluster‑map graphic (use `G` to display it).

steps.title: Run geoprofiling analysis
steps.instruction: Perform geographic profiling on the dataset using the specified parameters.

substeps.instruction: Run: `python Geoprof2_0_5csv.py mediterraneolarge.bmp caulerpaprol.csv risultati B E 10 0.4 0.4`.
• `10` – variable B in the geoprofiling formula.

steps.title: Inspect generated output files
steps.instruction: Verify that the expected result files have been created.

substeps.instruction: Check for `risultati.png`, which contains the geoprofiling visualization.
Check for `vorondiagblend_5_clust.png`, which shows the space divided into Voronoi tessellations.
